First announcement

The 12th meeting is planned for 23–24 August 2027 at Macau University of Science and Technology. Basic scientists, clinicians, early-career investigators and postgraduate students are invited to share new work on vascular biology, disease mechanisms and translational research.

Preliminary programme

Pre-meeting activities take place on 22 August. Session times, parallel sessions, dinner arrangements and rooms will be published once confirmed.

  1. 22AUG
    Sunday

    Pre-meeting activities

    Council Meeting in the afternoon. An invited-guest dinner is planned for the evening; venue to be confirmed.

  2. 23AUG
    Monday

    Scientific sessions · full day

    Scientific lectures, the Young Scholar Forum and posters. A conference dinner for all participants is planned; venue and attendance arrangements to be confirmed.

  3. 24AUG
    Tuesday

    Scientific sessions · morning

    Scientific presentations and the closing session.

Attendance and registration

Download the attendance intention form and email the completed copy to the Conference Secretary-General. This initial form records attendance intentions only; indicate if you require an official invitation letter. Registration and payment details will follow.

Download the attendance intention formDOCX

Send completed forms to pharmc@sustech.edu.cn

Tentative registration fees (CNY)
Provisional fees for the 12th meeting
CategoryEarly birdStandard
Regular delegate¥2,500¥3,000

The early-bird deadline is tentatively 1 May 2027. All participants are generally required to pay the registration fee. Fee waivers, deadline rules, meal and dinner inclusions, and refunds remain to be confirmed in the formal registration announcement.

Call for abstracts

Abstracts are invited on vascular biology, mechanisms of vascular disease and related translational research for oral or poster presentation. Early-career researchers and postgraduate students are encouraged to submit abstracts and participate in the Young Scholar Forum.

Please use the abstract template and include the title, authors, affiliations, abstract text, keywords and corresponding author details. Indicate your preferred presentation format on the attendance intention form. Acceptance and presentation arrangements will be communicated by the Organizing Committee. The abstract deadline and formal submission instructions will be published once confirmed.

Download the abstract templateDOCX

Accommodation and travel

Participants are generally responsible for their own accommodation costs. Recommended hotels, conference rates, routes and room details will be provided once confirmed.

Please check institutional travel approval and reimbursement requirements, as well as the travel documents and entry permissions applicable to Macao.
